attr.title: Kor
attr.desc: Kor is a retro RPG with a variety of eccentric characters, goofy dialog, and turn-based combat where - in addition to strategizing - players must skillfully execute button combos in order to make attacks!
attr.inst: Purchase the game on Steam and copy game files into assets folder.
attr.inst_md: Purchase the game on [Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1374280/Kor/) and copy game files into `assets` folder.
